integrity: Correctness rests on the chain-ring support criterion, an explicit rank-r real Gram matrix, an explicit forcing sequence leaving exactly r white ideals, and the standard maximum-nullity bound.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonreduced finite commutative principal ideal rings.
The local nilpotency-length-two graph K1 is an explicit exceptional boundary.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices.
The theorem determines minimum size but not every minimum zero forcing set.
title: Zero forcing recovers the local-factor count of nonreduced finite principal ideal rings
